class.name: VehicleTelemetry
class.brief_description: Telemetry node that reads and exposes vehicle drivetrain data for UI or debugging.
class.description:
VehicleTelemetry is a [Node] that reads an immutable [VehicleTelemetrySnapshot] value from a [Vehicle] and exposes it through readable accessors. It caches the target's wheel layout once it is available, then reuses bounded arrays for per-wheel values. Pass a [Wheel] reference to [method get_wheel_rpm], [method get_tire_force], or [method get_tire_telemetry] when data for one tire is needed. Clutch engagement, requested torque, transmitted torque, output torque, signed slip, and slipping state are flattened scalar snapshot fields. It can auto-detect its target by checking the parent or sibling nodes, or assign one manually via [method set_target].
Use this node to display real-time data like RPM, speed, gear, and clutch engagement in a HUD or debug overlay.

method.name: get_engine_reaction_telemetry
method.description: Reads the latest completed physics snapshot. Keys: generated_torque (Nm, last engine substep, including idle support); reaction_torque and vibration_torque (signed frame-average Nm along engine_axis); vibration_amplitude (frame-average Nm after speed fading and the torque cap); vibration_frequency (frame-average Hz after band limiting); speed_factor (frame-average speed fade multiplier, 0 to 1); chassis_torque (applied world-space Vector3 in Nm). A zero axis or disabled/missing resource reports zero reaction and vibration. Dictionary allocation occurs only on request.

method.name: get_handling_telemetry
method.description: Completed physics snapshot: ESC yaw target/error (rad/s), raw requested and applied torque (Nm), cap/slew/support/speed gate flags; body-frame sideslip (rad), bounded filtered trend (rad/s), validity, yaw rate/acceleration, lateral acceleration; driver steering, rack target/actual (rad), raw/applied SAT (Nm). Sideslip trend is valid only for forward speed at least 3 m/s and resets across invalid history. Its derivative is bounded to 10 rad/s and filtered with a 0.1 s time constant. Diagnostic history does not affect ESC torque. Tire telemetry also includes current world wheel axes, final lateral/longitudinal forces and SAT. Dictionaries are constructed on request, outside the physics solver.

method.name: set_target
method.description: Sets the target [Vehicle] node to read telemetry from.

method.name: get_target
method.description: Returns the target [Vehicle] node.

method.name: get_engine_rpm
method.description: Returns the current engine RPM.

method.name: get_engine_torque
method.description: Returns the engine's current torque output in Newton-meters.

method.name: get_engine_throttle
method.description: Returns the current throttle input (0.0 to 1.0).

method.name: get_driveshaft_rpm
method.description: Returns the driveshaft angular velocity converted to RPM.

method.name: get_clutch_engagement
method.description: Returns the clutch engagement level (0.0 = fully disengaged, 1.0 = fully locked).

method.name: get_clutch_requested_torque
method.description: Returns the requested engine-side clutch torque in the engine-to-output sign convention: positive requests torque from the engine toward the driveshaft, negative requests the opposite. Returns 0.0 in neutral.

method.name: get_clutch_transmitted_torque
method.description: Returns the applied clutch torque on the engine-to-output sign convention. Positive values transmit torque from engine to output; negative values transmit torque from output to engine. Returns 0.0 in neutral.

method.name: get_clutch_output_torque
method.description: Returns transmitted clutch torque after the signed selected gear ratio, as torque delivered into the driveshaft and driven axles. Reverse ratios therefore reverse the sign. Returns 0.0 in neutral.

method.name: get_clutch_slip
method.description: Returns signed clutch-row slip in rad/s: engine angular velocity minus signed gear ratio times driveshaft angular velocity. Returns 0.0 in neutral.

method.name: get_clutch_slipping
method.description: Returns whether the clutch solve reports slip (the clutch row is not connected). Returns false in neutral.

method.name: get_current_gear
method.description: Returns the currently engaged gear. 0 = neutral, positive = forward gears, negative = reverse.

method.name: get_gear_ratio
method.description: Returns the effective gear ratio (selected gear ratio x final drive).

method.name: get_vehicle_speed_kph
method.description: Returns the vehicle's speed in kilometers per hour.

method.name: get_turbo_boost
method.description: Returns the current turbo boost value from the cached vehicle snapshot.

method.name: get_wheel_rpms
method.description: Returns wheel speeds in RPM, flattened in axle order.

method.name: get_tire_forces
method.description: Returns an array of per-wheel tire forces (world-space vectors), one per wheel across all axles.

method.name: get_wheel_rpm
method.description: Returns the selected wheel's speed in RPM, or 0.0 for a [code]null[/code] reference.

method.name: get_tire_force
method.description: Returns the selected wheel's world-space tire force, or a zero vector for a [code]null[/code] reference.

method.name: get_tire_telemetry
method.description: Returns runtime data for one tire. Keys are [code]wheel[/code], [code]wheel_rpm[/code], [code]tire_force[/code], [code]normal_load[/code], [code]slip_ratio[/code], [code]slip_angle_degrees[/code], [code]grounded[/code], [code]sliding[/code], [code]abs_active[/code], [code]contact_position[/code], [code]contact_normal[/code], and [code]grip_multiplier[/code]. Returns an empty dictionary for a [code]null[/code] reference.
